channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: PolyPine
item.description: A forest simulator where you grow trees and create habitats for animals, plants and insects. Click on animals to make them poop, hunt, dig, cut and twerk! Start with a few basic seeds and attempt to grow a thriving ecosystem.

item.title: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
item.description: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

item.title: Tensei Brave
item.description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

item.title: Thymesia
item.description: Thymesia is a gruelling action-RPG with fast-paced combat and an intricate plague weapon system. In a kingdom where death spreads, play as a mysterious character known by the code name "Corvus". Prey upon your enemies, wield the power of disease and find the truth in your own memories.

item.title: ASPIS
item.description: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.

item.title: BloomTale
item.description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

item.title: DeadPoly
item.description: DeadPoly is a polygon arcade zombie survival looter shooter with base building, crafting, scavenging, leveling, questing, and more, but your only goal is survival, everything else is optional.

item.title: Draugen
item.description: Draugen is a single-player, first-person Fjord Noir mystery set in 1920s Norway. Explore a forgotten coastal village in your search for your missing sister, accompanied by your independent and enigmatic young ward. Norwegian Game of the Year 2019.

item.title: Pathologic 3
item.description: In this psychological horror game, you are a doctor with only 12 days to save a town from a mysterious plague. Make ruthless decisions and diagnose with precision. Shape the town's future and rewrite the past. Hold yourself together while it all falls apart.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Peru Hunting Reserve
item.description: From Andean peaks to dense jungles, explore Peru’s extreme biodiversity. Hunt a massive roster from tarucas to caimans. Stay vigilant: the jungle is the jaguar’s kingdom.

item.title: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
item.description: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

item.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship
item.description: Hailed by reviewers and professional drivers, the standard-setting off-road racing simulation has been reinvented! Reach the 2021 season podium, and to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the competition, relive the highlights at the wheel of legendary cars.

item.title: Under Canopies
item.description: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

item.title: Moon Sweepers
item.description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

item.title: One Way Tickets
item.description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

item.title: Dungeon Inn
item.description: This is a cozy strategy management game where you manage an inn placed cleverly at the mouth of a dungeon. Juggle visits and business from 2 rivaling guilds, maximize profits, but keep your double-dealing a secret! Keep everyone happy and watch your inn thrive!

item.title: Sker Ritual
item.description: Tear through endless waves of supernatural enemies in this co-op horror horde shooter. Play solo or with up to 4 players, unleash god-like Miracle powers, supercharge your arsenal, and survive devastating boss encounters on Sker Island.

item.title: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries
item.description: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries stars the iconic, blade-wielding character from Robert Kirkman's best-selling comic books.

item.title: Victoria 3: Sphere of Influence - Expansion
item.description: Pull other nations into your orbit through diplomatic skill, economic leverage or straightforward bribery. Building a durable international faction of like-minded governments, pursuing common goals for a common good and the glory of your power.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.
